# Display snippets for docs/type_checking.md

--8<-- [start:atom_vs_string]
atom(bar),          string("bar")        % both true
\+ atom("bar"),     \+ string(bar)       % neither kind is the other
atomic(bar),        \+ atomic("bar")     % a string is a list, not atomic
compound("bar"),    atom("")             % ISO: a list is '.'/2; [] is an atom
is_list("bar"),     is_chars("bar")      % ... so every list test accepts it
"" == [],           string("")           % the empty string IS the empty list
--8<-- [end:atom_vs_string]
